# RapidFix Auto

> Expert auto and diesel repair shop in Scarborough, Ontario. Brakes, diagnostics, fleet maintenance, vehicle maintenance, diesel repair and Safety Standards Certificate (SSC) inspections — fast, honest, and affordable service at 112 Sinnott Rd, Scarborough, ON M1L 4S6.

RapidFix Auto is a full-service auto repair shop serving Scarborough and the Greater Toronto Area. We service all vehicle types — cars, trucks, and diesel vehicles — for both personal and commercial/fleet customers. Most repairs are covered by a 12-month / 20,000 km warranty on parts and labour.

## Services

- [Auto Repair in Scarborough](https://www.rapidfixauto.ca/services/auto-repair-in-scarborough/): General auto repair for all makes and models — brakes, suspension, exhaust, electrical and more.
- [Diesel Repair in Scarborough](https://www.rapidfixauto.ca/services/diesel-repair-in-scarborough/): Diesel engine diagnostics and repair for trucks and commercial vehicles.
- [Vehicle Diagnostics in Scarborough](https://www.rapidfixauto.ca/services/vehicle-diagnostics-in-scarborough/): Computer diagnostics, check-engine-light diagnosis and electrical fault finding.
- [Vehicle Maintenance in Scarborough](https://www.rapidfixauto.ca/services/vehicle-maintenance-in-scarborough/): Oil changes, tune-ups, fluid services and scheduled maintenance.
- [Fleet Services in Scarborough](https://www.rapidfixauto.ca/services/fleet-services-in-scarborough/): Fleet maintenance and repair programs for commercial vehicles.
- [Safety Standards Certificate](https://www.rapidfixauto.ca/services/safety-standards-certificate-in-scarborough/): Ontario Ministry of Transportation SSC inspections for buying, selling or registering a vehicle.
